# Third-party, real-world fixtures

**These four documents are not ours and were not generated by this repository.** Every
other fixture under `tests/fixtures/` is written by a committed `tools/make_*.py` script;
these were supplied by the user as a real-world test of the style cascade and are kept
apart, in this directory, so that the distinction stays visible.

| File | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `sample-blank.docx` | `2153f291a59ef00b5ebd7a82ed1fa4a45bbf0ee6bff358246c3180c089e8b2da` |
| `sample-long.docx` | `2bdc6318e9dd8432669b6924f21cd377ce0b0230ae523ed3a6672e498f8bad12` |
| `sample-resume.docx` | `96d847f22db0002f4976b941eddf0bd70d5b05146e3088dcfcfa88f58347d422` |
| `sample-simple.docx` | `bd8d8f3cd62f4910257f7567743a58291d17ac2ee3383b7fd8b4a813237391d6` |

- **Source:** <https://samplelib.com/sample-docx.html>
- **Downloaded:** 2026-09-24
- **Licence** (<https://samplelib.com/license.html>, verbatim): *"After downloading from
  the sample library, do whatever you want with the files (change, supplement, use as you
  like)."* No attribution is required; this note is kept anyway.
- **Contents checked before committing:** no embedded fonts (no `word/fonts/` part), no
  font data of any kind; PNG figures and a JPEG thumbnail only.

What they are, as far as the files say: the styles part, theme and `settings.xml`
(`compatibilityMode` 14, `w:themeFontLang` en-US / ja-JP) are those of a Word for Mac
2011 template, and the body is written with single-quoted XML declarations, which Word
does not emit -- so the bodies were most likely produced programmatically on top of that
template. They are "real-world" in their styles, not in their authoring. Every face is
named through the theme (major Calibri, minor Cambria) or a style; the only direct run
formatting is `w:b` / `w:i`.

Word's exports of them are not committed (a PDF carries font subsets). Their measured
baselines are, in `../baseline-observations.json`.
